name: Dried persimmon
summary: Persimmon dried in the open air or cold-dried until chewy, a fragrant highland sweet.
origin: Dried persimmon among the Da Lat persimmon specialties, favored in highlands such as Da Lat.
texture: The fruit is dried in open air or cold-dried so it stays chewy.
howToEat: Eat it as a sweet, or carry it home. A seasonal fair in a Cam Ly resort yard also sells fragrant dried persimmon.
where: Persimmon orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, and shops in town. The Cam Ly fair runs quarterly, monthly, or weekly, depending on the host.
